subject: Proposal: Consolidated telemetry SKUs — volume-credit scenario
messages:
From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@lumendata.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidating observability SKUs — request for volume-credit scenarios

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the new dashboarding widgets look really promising for our SRE teams. We ran the usage export for Q2 (attached) and want to explore simplifying the add-on structure. Right now we pay separately for retention, tracing ingest, and advanced dashboard seats. That fragmentation is adding billing ops overhead and makes forecasting hard.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood propose a single consolidated SKU (e.g., "Observability Essentials") that bundles 30-day retention + tracing ingest + advanced dashboard access, with a clear overage rate?
- For 12–24 month volume commitments, what kind of credits/discounts do you offer? We're targeting a committed retention footprint of ~1.2 PB/year and expect steady tracing ingest.

Attached is a usage snapshot (LumenData_usage_snapshot_Q2.csv) and a short spreadsheet with what we'd consider "starter" seat counts. Ideally we'd see: a) tiered per-PB price bands, b) a guaranteed unit price for the contract term, and c) a pilot credit to validate dashboards at full scale.

Can you share a proposal and some example math by EOD Friday? If helpful we can do a 30-min sync.

Cheers,
Sarah
Sarah Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, LumenData
ops-platform@lumendata.com

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-01T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating observability SKUs — request for volume-credit scenarios

Hi Sarah — great to hear the demo resonated. Appreciate the usage export, that's exactly what we need to run accurate unit economics. I'm attaching a quick draft SKU matrix (Consolidated_SKU_matrix_v1.xlsx) — initial idea is a three-tier consolidated SKU (Starter / Scale / Enterprise) with explicit per-PB price bands and a per-seat dashboard addon for power users.

Preliminary suggestions:
- Enterprise tier (>=1 PB/month sustained): aggressive per-PB pricing, included 30-day retention, tracing ingest up to configured caps, and up to 200 dashboard seats.
- Volume credits: for a 12-month commit we can apply 15% volume credit on list; for 24-month commits we can consider 22% — subject to final usage floors.
- Pilot offer: 3 months of dashboard credits (up to $25k of billables) to validate queries at production scale.

I'll pull Kimberly in on the finalized pricing math — want to make sure we present conservative overage rates and clear SLAs. If you're free Friday 10am PT we can walk through the matrix.

Regards,
Lukas Meyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidating observability SKUs — internal pricing checks

Lukas / Vanessa — quick internal note after reviewing Sarah's data and your draft matrix. A few items to consider before sending a formal offer: 

1) Floor vs. actuals: LumenData's Q2 looks spiky — we should recommend a smoothing floor for committed PBs to avoid over-discounting on ephemeral spikes. Suggest committed floor = 75% of 90-day median.
2) Discount bands: the 15/22% numbers are reasonable, but Enterprise deals in this bracket often request an additional one-off adoption credit (we can front-load a credit vs. lower list price). Recommend structuring as: 20% list discount + $30k pilot credit for 12-month; 25% + $50k for 24-month. We should keep space to move.
3) Dashboards seats: propose including 100 seats in Enterprise and price additional seats at incremental $15/seat/month.
4) Legal/finance: if we push >20% discount, finance wants a signed MSA + revenue recognition schedule.

I've attached a quick counter matrix (internal) and flagged the places finance will push back.

Kimberly
Director, Pricing Strategy

Kim / Lukas — forwarding my suggested concession matrix and approval ask to loop in Aditya. Summary below (copied into the body for quick review):

Suggested concession tiers (recommended for LumenData):
- 12-mo commit, >=9 PB total/year: 20% off list + $30k pilot credit; 30-day retention included; tracing overage $0.03/ingested-GPU-hour equivalent
- 24-mo commit, >=18 PB total/year: 25% off list + $50k pilot credit + 2 months free dashboards; reduced overage $0.02/ingested-GPU-hour eq.
- Contract addendum: guaranteed unit price for term, quarterly true-ups 

Requesting Aditya's sign-off to offer the 24-month concession (25% + $50k credit + 2 months dashboards) for a strategic win — LumenData is a high-profile platform customer and could surface Redwood in their partner case studies. If Aditya approves, I'll draft a customer-facing offer and legal terms.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Enterprise Sales
